explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/23 at n = 5 and OEIS A389646, cited in the file, which reports a(5k) = k² for 1 ≤ k ≤ 40 (Ferudun, 2026), so a(25) = 25. The Lean statement says every triangle-free graph on Fin 25 becomes bipartite by deleting at most 25 edges, with H ≤ G bipartite and the deleted set counted. The docstring attributes the result to BCL and McKay's catalogue, whereas OEIS credits Ferudun; I did not resolve that attribution. Statement faithful.
